title: Edmund and the Ghost
author: Orsen Dravenmoor
blurb: Bram Iversen, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
